name: SAT>IP Freesat
description: SAT>IP tuner and UK Freesat EPG source for Jellyfin. Scans DVB-S SI tables directly, selects the correct regional bouquet by postcode, and assigns proper Freesat LCNs. No tvheadend required.

versions.changelog: Fix settings not saving/loading: config load/save now uses direct ajax calls instead of ApiClient helper methods that are absent in some Jellyfin builds. Fix scan status always showing dash: all API response types now carry explicit JSON property names.
Scan progress bar: indeterminate pulse during NIT/BAT phase, 0-100% during mux SDT scan. Fix Invalid Date on status page. Status page polls at 2s while scanning, 10s otherwise.
